name: Due dates
summary: Due dates: reads the invoices still owed and the open project deadlines in Xero, drafts one internal task in Xero Projects for each deadline coming up, and queues a chase email for each overdue invoice. Crons read, draft and queue; a person approves every client email before Xero sends it.

crons.name: scan
crons.summary: Read invoices owed and open project deadlines; draft an internal Xero Projects task for each deadline inside the window (21:00 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Queue Xero's invoice email for each invoice overdue by the set days, for a person to approve.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads, plus one internal task in Xero Projects per project deadline. A task reaches nobody outside the business. Emailing an invoice reaches a client, so it is a live operation: the chase cron only queues it and a person approves it.

xero.covers: invoices awaiting payment and their due dates (reads); open project deadlines (reads); one internal task per deadline in Xero Projects (drafted); Xero's invoice email for an overdue invoice (queued for approval)

gaps: Ignition and Karbon: their help pages were read, but neither platform has operations mapped in the kit, so deadline capture, diary entries, reminders and work allocation there stay manual.
Statutory and tax due dates (BAS, PAYG, lodgments with the ATO) are not in Xero's API or the mapped docs. They stay on the practice's own compliance calendar.
Xero Projects tasks have no due date field. The deadline sits on the project (deadlineUtc), and the task carries the date in its name only.
Moving a project deadline after a client agrees a new date needs a person's decision and a full project update (projects.updateProject). Not built: no cron queues it.
Xero's invoice reminder settings are read-only in the kit (accounting.getInvoiceReminders). Xero's own automatic reminders cannot be switched on from this workflow.
The chase email is Xero's standard invoice email. A chase written in the practice's own words needs a mailbox adapter, which this build does not include.
Xero's date format (/Date(ms)/ or ISO text) is handled in code but not yet confirmed against a live or demo organisation. Confirm before a live run.
Docs-only until a Xero demo organisation proves the reads, the task draft and the invoice email. A contact with no email address fails at approval, so check contacts first.
Judgment steps stay with the practice: confirming work is done, asking a client for an extension, escalating a missed deadline, and assigning work to a person.
